answer: In this EigenTrust-based network, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so maintaining influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity lets trusted interactions carry weight, while fresh Sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus on their own. Each service pulse adds evidence; pigment marks no privilege, and a sudden score delta cannot replace accumulated trust.
